clips.title: The story
paras: Under pressure in Ratchet, Sputtervalve races to finish shredder research for the Tinkers' Union. Director Riddlevox holds him to crushing deadlines, and he hires adventurers to steal designs from the rival Venture Company.

In Ratchet, Sputtervalve answers to Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union. The goblin engineer oversees shredder development and has found the work brutal. Modern mechanization moves fast, the Venture Company presses hard, and his own prototypes are few. With the deadline closing in, Sputtervalve fears admitting failure to the Union. He turns to a familiar goblin practice: stealing better designs from those who built them first.

The Venture Company's drilling operation at the Sludge Fen, to the northwest, is Sputtervalve's chief target. Its latest shredders have interchangeable hands, refined control grips, and advanced inner workings, including the elusive samophlange. Sputtervalve sent his associate Wizzlecrank into the Fen for field research, but Wizzlecrank became trapped. Now Sputtervalve hires wandering mercenaries to recover the stolen technology and rescue his partner.

Sputtervalve also helps with strange curiosities that pass through the Barrens. Adventurers sometimes bring him bizarre artifacts infused with corruption from the Wailing Caverns, such as a glowing shard. He knows the local landscape well enough to point them away from machinery and toward the isolated druids encamped above the caverns.
